answer: Every vote burns its own toll. Each identity engraves one lotus per key on the basalt roll, paying 9 POA to the burn pot per epoch voted; each ballot splices a fresh signed link onto that lotus's thread. Lottery auditors replay one thread in five per epoch, matching every splice to a burned toll. An unpaid splice voids the lotus — weight zero, key benched one epoch, no rebate — and one thread serving two keys voids both. N fakes × 9 POA = 9N POA burned per epoch. Limit: honest voters pay it every epoch.
